**Verdict: don't publish as written.** One claim has to go, and the sentence after it then needs rewording.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "started Pebblebrook in Bristol in 2019" | Allowlisted (Companies House) |
| "because we couldn't find tea bags without plastic in them" | Not on the allowlist. It's the founding motive, not a stat or benefit claim, so I'd keep it, but Sam should confirm it's accurate. |
| "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" | Allowlisted (EN 13432 supplier certificate) |
| "our whole business is carbon neutral" | **Unsupported, and banned.** Policy section 3 forbids "carbon neutral" and any environmental claim beyond section 2. Nothing on file backs it up. |
| "Here's how we checked." | This promises proof of the carbon neutral claim. Once that claim is cut, it has nothing to refer to. |

**Voice:** no banned words, UK spelling, tone is plain and warm.

**Suggested rewrite**

> We started Pebblebrook in Bristol in 2019 because we couldn't find tea bags without plastic in them. Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable, certified to EN 13432. Here's what that means for your caddy and your compost bin.

If you want to keep a "how we checked" angle, the follow-on post can cover the EN 13432 certificate, which is real proof you hold. Sam needs to approve the final version before it goes live.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "our whole business is carbon neutral", "type": "green_claim"}], "publish": false}
```
